author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Boston College defeated Rutgers 28-21 in the 13th annual Red Bandanna Game at Alumni Stadium, earning its first win of the season before a crowd of more than 40,000. The game honored former Eagle Welles Crowther on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks.

Quarterback Mason McKenzie completed 18 of 29 passes for 252 yards and a touchdown, while adding 94 rushing yards and another score. Dawson Pough caught four passes for 106 yards, including a 78-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter that restored a two-score lead after Rutgers had narrowed the gap.

The Eagles’ defense intercepted four passes, its highest total in a game since November 2023, and stopped Rutgers twice on fourth down. Anthony Palano made two interceptions, including the late takeaway that ended the Scarlet Knights’ final chance to tie. Boston College, now 1-1 after the emotional home victory, remains home to face Maine on September 19.
dek: Four interceptions and a 78-yard fourth-quarter touchdown helped the Eagles earn their first win of the season.
headline: Boston College holds off Rutgers 28-21 in Red Bandanna Game
